title: 第180章 狩猎诅咒第179章 假死托生
lines: 年幼的狄娥尼索斯没多想，顺着那洞就溜出了城。
可世上哪有不透风的墙，偏偏就有一个宁芙撞个正着。
“呀？那孩子......不是宙斯大人的私生子（女）吗？”
那宁芙掩住红唇，一双美眸中闪过一丝惊诧。
她倒是个聪明人。她深知，要是把这事捅到赫拉那儿或者满大街宣扬，自己绝对落不着好下场。
于是，她表面上揣着明白装糊涂，转头却和几个贴心的闺蜜嚼起了舌根。
坏就坏在，闺蜜也有闺蜜，一传十，十传百，不过眨眼功夫，狄娥尼索斯还活着的秘密，在圈子里就已经成了公开的秘密。
当这风声传遍诸族，连心里还有些算计的赫拉，这回也坐不住了。
毕竟这直接关乎她天后的威严，她明明已经对外宣称那孩子已死，如今打脸来得如此之快，任谁都会在她背后指指点点。
不过，念在昔日塞墨勒的情分上，赫拉到底还是留了一线慈悲。她没亲自动手，而是降下神谕，将差事派给了阿耳忒弥斯。
“阿耳忒弥斯，我知道你素来厌恶阿塔马斯，去把他逼疯。”
赫拉端坐在宝座上，那双凤眸中闪烁着冷冽的光芒。
“当真？属下领命！”
阿耳忒弥斯闻言大喜。她那张冷艳绝伦的面容上浮现出一抹快意的笑容，澄澈如冰湖的眼眸中闪过嗜血的光芒。
她早就盘算着怎么收拾阿塔马斯那家伙了，如今得了天后首肯，正中下怀。
她虽是狩猎女神，却最恶阿塔马斯这种赶尽杀绝的劣质猎人。
是夜，阿耳忒弥斯悄然降临。
月光下，她的身姿清冷而锋利。那袭银白色的战裙在夜风中轻轻飘动，勾勒出她那修长而曼妙的身段。
她俯下身，将神灵的吐息拂过熟睡中的阿塔马斯，夺走了他的神智。
“你虽为猎人，却毫无狩猎之德。既然如此，便在无休止的杀戮中迎向毁灭吧。”
阿塔马斯嗜猎成性，最绝的是他每逢进山，必行绝户之举，连山里的异族也不放过。正因如此，阿耳忒弥斯早就想废了他。
奈何他是维奥蒂亚的国王，不在她的神职疆域内，若非犯下滔天大罪，她也无权擅动。
翌日清晨，疯癫的阿塔马斯睁开眼，内殿里的侍从、宫人，落在他眼里全成了乱窜的麋鹿与野猪。
老猎人的本能瞬间占了上风，他眼里泛起嗜血的光芒。
“哦？居然有幼鹿自投罗网，运气不错。”
噗嗤！
不愧是老手，羽箭破空，精准地洞穿了“幼鹿”的心脏，一击毙命。
那“幼鹿”甚至来不及发出一声惨叫，便软软地倒在了地上，鲜血在光洁的地板上缓缓蔓延开来。
“哈哈，本王宝刀未老！”
阿塔马斯扛起死去的“鹿”，兴冲冲地往肢解场走去。
而这一幕，恰好落在了刚赶来的伊诺眼中。在她看来，那是阿塔马斯一箭射死了他们的长子勒阿耳科斯，正准备去剥皮抽筋。
伊诺倒吸一口凉气，那张美丽的面容瞬间变得惨白。
“这......这是神明的诅咒！”
伊诺瞬间反应过来。她强忍着悲痛与恐惧，一把拉过幼子梅利凯尔特斯和狄娥尼索斯，拔腿就往外跑。

;;
The young Dionysus didn't think much and slipped out of the city along the hole.
But there is no airtight wall in the world, but a nymph bumped into it.
"Ah? Isn't that child... the illegitimate son (female) of Lord Zeus?"
The nymph covered her red lips, a look of surprise flashed in her beautiful eyes.
She is quite a smart person. She knew very well that if she brought this matter to Hera or spread it on the streets, she would never end well.
So, on the surface, she pretended to be confused, but turned around and chatted with a few caring girlfriends.
The bad thing is, best friends also have best friends, and they are passed down from one person to another, but in the blink of an eye, the secret that Dionysus is still alive has become an open secret in the circle.
When the news spread throughout the clans, even Hera, who still had some calculations in her heart, couldn't sit still this time.
After all, this is directly related to the majesty of her queen. She has clearly declared that the child is dead, but now the slap in the face comes so quickly, anyone will point fingers behind her back.
However, thinking of her past love for Semele, Hera still left a glimmer of mercy. Instead of taking action herself, she sent down an oracle and sent the errand to Artemis.
"Artemis, I know you have always hated Athamas and drove him crazy."
Hera sat on the throne, with a cold light shining in her phoenix eyes.
"Seriously? This subordinate takes orders!"
Artemis was overjoyed when she heard this. A happy smile appeared on her cold and stunning face, and a bloodthirsty light flashed in her eyes as clear as an ice lake.
She had long been thinking about how to deal with that Atamas guy, and now she had the Queen's approval, which was exactly what she wanted.
Although she is the goddess of hunting, she hates inferior hunters like Athamas the most.
It was night, Artemis came quietly.
Under the moonlight, her figure was cold and sharp. The silver-white war skirt fluttered gently in the night wind, outlining her slender and graceful figure.
She leaned down and blew the breath of the god over the sleeping Atamas, taking away his consciousness.
"Although you are a hunter, you have no hunting virtue. In this case, face destruction in the endless killing."
Atamas is a hunter by nature, and the most unique thing is that whenever he goes into the mountains, he will commit acts of extermination, even to the aliens in the mountains. Because of this, Artemis had long wanted to destroy him.
However, he was the king of Boeotia and was not within her clerical territory. Unless he committed a heinous crime, she had no right to interfere.
The next morning, the crazy Athamas opened his eyes. In his eyes, the attendants and palace people in the inner palace turned into scurrying elk and wild boar.
The old hunter's instinct instantly took over, and his eyes glowed with bloodlust.
"Oh? A young deer actually threw itself into the trap. You're lucky."
Poof!
As expected of a veteran, the arrow shot through the air and accurately pierced the "young deer"'s heart, killing him with one blow.
The "young deer" didn't even have time to let out a scream before he fell softly to the ground, and blood slowly spread on the smooth floor.
"Haha, my sword is not old yet!"
Atamas picked up the dead "deer" and walked excitedly to the dismemberment site.
And this scene happened to fall in the eyes of Ino, who had just arrived. It seemed to her that Athamas had killed their eldest son Learchus with an arrow and was about to be skinned and cramped.
Hiss——
Ino took a breath, and that beautiful face instantly turned pale.
"This...this is a curse from the gods!"
Ino reacted instantly. She suppressed her grief and fear, grabbed her youngest sons Melikeites and Dionysus, and ran out.
